title: Ticket 1.61.10 — تلفن تردد و یادآور روزانهٔ بازرسی (R8)
notes: R8 requires exactly an 11-digit visitor phone including the fixed 09 prefix and adds a once-daily 11:00 food-absence reminder popup, strictly limited to inspection users. It preserves the current R7 destination/approver and traffic-history features.
